title: A Zeno model fits binocular rivalry data

statements.text: Manousakis's quantum treatment of binocular rivalry, which uses the Zeno effect, fits the complex empirical data well, and decoherence in the warm brain will not upset the Zeno effect it uses.

sources.quote: it is argued, on the basis of fundamental principles, that the usual decoherence effects will not upset the quantum Zeno effect that is being exploited in the cited work
